en: The front of the postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a well-manicured park or garden with balustrade staircases, flower beds, decorative shrubbery, and a prominent music pavilion or bandstand. There are people strolling or standing in the park, and large trees dominate the background. The top of the postcard has printed German text reading 'Bad Pyrmont, Vor der Kurhausterrasse'. The back of the postcard features dense handwritten German text, an address, and a stamp from 'Deutsches Reich' with a postmark dated 15.6.24. A logo for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont' is also present.
